kotlin-for-forge:
Used to make mods with the Kotlin programming language. Works by shading the Kotlin libraries, providing KotlinLanguageProvider to load @Mod object declarations, providing AutoKotlinEventBusSubscriber to load @EventBusSubscriber declarations, and providing useful utility functions and constants.

As of Kotlin for Forge 1.8.0, this provides Kotlin 1.4.21, Kotlin coroutines 1.4.2, Kotlin JSON serialization 1.0.1, and Jetbrains annotations 20.1.0.

 

 If you're not a mod developer, this is a dependency mod. 
 
 

Unlike Kottle, this library (as of 1.2.0) provides its own implementation of IEventBus that supports IEventBus addListener and IEventBus addGenericListener with function references.

 

Information for how to implement can be found here.
You do not have to use the language loader or any of the features Kotlin for Forge provides, you can just use it for the bundled Kotlin libraries
moonlight:
Features of this library are:

- Dynamic resource pack utilities
A set of utilities that allow creating dynamic runtime resource packs and datapacks. Also easily allows respriting and retexturing existing textures, specifically useful to add new wood based blocks.

 

- Dynamic block set registration
Allows mods to specify a block set (which can be for example a wood type). The mod then will scan all registered blocks and fill the block set up only to then allow mods to register blocks that depend on it.

This can't be easily done using traditional methods since the wood set itself depends on the registered blocks so registration must happen at a very specific time. This utility makes that task possible and easy to do. Note that it is still a form of dynamic registration which might have some drawbacks.

In a nutshell you have dynamic wood type support for your blocks. The wood set type

This mod makes item frames easier to build with by allowing you to toggle the visibility of item frames! This is normally possible only through commands, however this mod provides an easier, more survival-friendly, method of creating and managing invisible item frames.

 As a side note: 
As this mod is just an interface for vanilla features, if you want your invisible item frames to go back to normal after the mod is uninstalled, you'll have to use this command: 

 /execute at @e run data merge entity @e[distance=1, limit=1, type=minecraft:item frame] {Invisible:0b} 

This will make all item frames in the immediate area visible again.

 
 Features 
 

- Toggle item frame visibility by sneak + right-click with an empty hand. (Server Only)

- Hold an item frame to make surrounding item frames visible. (Client Only)

- All item frames will be invisible by default on servers

servux:
Description

Servux is a server-side mod that provides extra support and features for some client-side mods when playing on a that server.

Servux itself is never needed on the clients or in single player . It's only needed/useful on the server side in multiplayer.

The only case where it's useful on the client, is for the player who hosts a LAN game. That way the other players who connect get the benefits just as they would on a dedicated server.

 Features
In version 0.1.x it only has one feature, which is sending structure bounding box data to MiniHUD when it asks for it, so that it can render the structure bounding boxes also in multiplayer.

There are a lot more features planned later on, at which point there will also be commands to turn features on or off. Currently in 0.1.x since there is only one feature, there are no commands yet. If you want the structure bounding box support,

ram-compat:
Relics: Alex's Mobs Compat (RAM-Compat) is an addon designed to seamlessly integrate with two popular Minecraft mods: Relics and Alex's Mobs. Relics is a mod that introduces a variety of unique and powerful artifacts into the game, each with its own special abilities and lore. Alex's Mobs, on the other hand, adds a diverse range of new creatures to Minecraft, each with distinct behaviors and characteristics. RAM-Compat bridges these two mods by introducing new relics that are specifically tailored to the mechanics and creatures introduced in Alex's Mobs. This integration not only expands the variety of relics available, but also ensures that they are thematically and functionally consistent with the creatures and features of Alex's Mobs, thereby enhancing the overall gameplay experience for users of both mods.

This mod requires Relics and Alex's Mobs!

This mod is really simple and does exactly what is said in its summary. After throwing an Ender Pearl, if it hits another living entity like a mob or another player you swap places with each other instead of you just teleporting over to where the pearl landed.

By default the mod works only when directly hitting someone with the pearl. You can change the mode in configs to use a radius instead. Changing the value in the config sets the range a mob needs to be from the Ender Pearl meaning the pearl can also land right next to a mob and still cause the swap. You can increase or decrease this distance via the config file that comes with this mod. For example if you set the value at 10 throwing a pearl into the ground causes everyone in a 10x10x10 radius to be teleported to your previous location.

global-narration-toggle:
Global Narration Toggle is a client-side mod that makes the start-up experience better, for everyone. While most don't need the narrator, some do. Disabling it entirely is not a good solution. How this mod works, is it checks for the narration setting in the global .minecraft folder. If it's disabled there, the accessibility onboarding screen won't be shown when the game starts in a new instance. When the narrator is enabled in any instance, the global setting is updated as well. Anyone who needs it, has access to it on start-up. For others, it'll be a one-time setting. The options file is updated automatically from in-game. The .minecraft folder in ./AppData/Roaming/ is used. If it doesn't exist, the folder will be created with an options.txt file containing only ' narrator:0 '. This still allows any new instances to be created, or the current to be used. 
 
 
 Before the mod on startup

vulkandreno:
VulkanDreno

Vulkan Dreno is a lightweight compatibility mod that fixes crashes affecting Supported Adreno 7xx GPUs on Android devices when using VulkanMod.

What problem does this fix?

Some Android devices (especially newer Adreno GPUs like 730, 740, A32 and others) expose Vulkan queue families differently than VulkanMod expects.  So this mod helps fix these incompatiblities for all versions of the VulkanMod that causes the issue on Android.  

 This can cause: 

Crashes on startup
Vulkan initialization failures
Rendering issues or complete incompatibility
What this mod does

 This mod patches VulkanMod’s internal queue selection logic to: 

Properly detect queue families on Android GPUs
Fallback to graphics queues when dedicated queues are missing
Prevent crashes caused by unsupported queue configurations
Improve compatibility with Adreno 7xx devices
Who is this for?
Android users run

EventJS

is a KubeJS addon that adds reloadable native events for KubeJS.

With EventJS, you can

 refresh your native event listeners without restarting the whole game or store the handler within a global['someId'] , which is both simpler and more performant.
 add/remove native event listeners as you like without relaunching, which was impossible in KubeJS for 1.16-1.20
 prevent your game from crashing if something goes wrong in your native event listener
 add event listener only in server/client side

 Usage

By default, EventJS will replace the original native event listening method to make it reloadable. So you actually don't need to learn anything new in order to use EventJS, just install it and you Forge event listening is reloadable now.

But, if you're looking for some more dynamic and well-defined event listending, you can use NativeEvents.onEvent(...) , and NativeEvents.onGener

Are you running a server and want to regain insight into what mods are used by your players? Well, too bad Forge removed that handy verbose log on player joins! This mod aims to replicate this functionality.

---

 What this mod does
- This mod is registering an empty argument, making it required on clients if your server has it installed. Players who try to remove it from their modpack can't join your server.
- When players join your server, the client sends a list of mods to the server ( /config/modlist snooper/ ).

 What this mod doesn't do
- Automatically ban people based on blacklisted mods
- Provide an easy way to list mods of users in-game

---

 Limitations
- Dedicated troublemakers with knowledge of Java can decompile this mod and create an evil twin, possibly suppressing the results.

puppet-players:
Puppet Players 
 
A fabric mod for fake 'puppet' players in Minecraft
 
 

 About The Project

Modern, simple implementation of the fake players implemented originally in Carpet Mod.

There are some fundamental differences to how these fake players are implemented in comparison to the original implementation in Carpet Mod.

This mod can be used alongside Carpet Mod, carpet's fake player actions will work on these puppet players; however, it's recommended to use the provided actions instead.

The aim of this mod is to keep the behaviour of the puppet players as accurate as possible to a real player:

- All the player ticking is done in the correct tick phase.
- The client code for player actions is simulated on the server.
- Puppet players send packets to interact with the server, like a real player.
- Maintaining compatibility with all mods.

Footprint
================
Footprint is a server-side Fabric mod to help keep your world file size manageable when players explore lots of terrain quickly, especially using Elytra.
Server admins often use (great) tools like MCA Selector to prune chunks that have only been loaded for a very short time. Footprint simply makes this process automatic by not saving those chunks in the first place.
There may be reasons you want a chunk to be saved even though it wasn't loaded for long enough, the mod also has a few config options for that.
Footprint does NOT delete chunks that have already been saved, so it will never decrease your world size. You can still prune old chunks manually.

 Commands

 - Hover over the message to see the number of tokens used and approximate cost of the API request.
- Use /setcontextlevel to set the context level of the model.
 - Higher context levels will provide the model with more information about the world and the player but will cost more per API request.

This mod can manage which mods the client can install and which ones are prohibited from being installed.

copper-item-pipes:
Copper Item Pipes Mod

 Overview
Copper Item Pipes adds functionality to all variants of copper grates , turning them into a simple item transport system. The pipes can be oxidized, waxed, or any state of copper without affecting functionality.

 Crafting
- Recipe : Vanilla's 4 Copper Blocks in a star (No changes here).
- All copper block variants (including waxed and oxidized) are accepted.

 

 How It Works
1. Item Input 
 - Only hoppers can insert items into the copper grates/pipes.
 - Droppers and dispensers cannot push items into these pipes.
2. Item Throughput 
 - Transfers full stacks at a time (unlike hoppers, which transfer one item at a time).
3. Visual Transfer 
 - Items are visibly moved through the grates.
 - If you break a grate with an item inside, that item will drop .
4. Splitting Paths 
 - If the pipe branches in multiple directions, the system picks one available path

bettergamma:
BetterGamma

Fullbright for Minecraft that leaves your video settings alone.

---

 
 
 
 

---

 What it does
Many fullbright mods crank your brightness setting past its limit. That value gets saved to options.txt , so turning the mod off or removing it can leave your game blinding, and other clients that share the file get it too.

BetterGamma never changes the setting. It only changes the brightness the game uses while it lights the world, so your own slider stays exactly where you left it.

Fullbright also gives you a hidden night vision effect that only your game sees. Shader packs that react to night vision light up with it, which plain brightness tweaks can't do. Servers can't clear it, and it never shows up in your effects.

Turning fullbright on or off fades smoothly instead of snapping, and shader packs that react to night vision fade with it.

---

 How do I use it?
BetterGamm

About the Mod 

This is a lightweight, standalone mod for both Forge and Fabric, designed to give players a fully automatable and logical way to produce Nether Quartz using the Create mod. It introduces a unique 2-step production line via Calcite, completely removing the need to mine in the Nether!

Please check the Files tab to download the correct version (Forge or Fabric) for your modpack.

The Recipes & How It Works This mod adds two new Mechanical Mixer recipes to create a complete production chain. No heating is required for either step!

Step 1: Calcite Production Mix 1x Cobblestone, 1x Bone Meal, and Water in a Basin to create Calcite.

clockwork
 This mods depends on FAPI, FLK and Silk.

 What?
This mod helps you reconnect to a server after a specfied delay. 
You can save and manage your delays using a client command.
 Why?
This is useful for teleport contraptions based on cats and pearl chambers, which rely on reconnection delay.
 How?
The main client-side command has three aliases: /reconnect , /timing and /clockwork . 
You can use whichever you like the most.
- /timing add - Creates and saves a new timing with specified delay in seconds.
- /timing run - Kicks you from the current server and reconnects you after dealy that is saved with this name.
- /timing delete - Deletes timing by name.

发条 此模组依赖于FAPI、FLK和Silk。 - 你说什么？ 此模组可帮助您在指定的延迟后重新连接到服务器。 您可以使用客户端命令保存和管理延迟。 为什么？为什么？ 这对基于猫和珍珠室的传送装置很有用，它们依赖于重新连接延迟。 怎么做？ 主要的客户端命令有三个别名：/reconnect、/timing和/clockwork。 你可以用你最喜欢的。 - /timing add-以指定的延迟（秒）建立并储存新的计时。 - /timing run-将您逐出当前服务器，并在使用此名称保存的会话结束后重新连接您。 - /timing delete-按名称删除计时。

behaviors from ~180 surveyed Modrinth sleep mods (deduped to 52 distinct features) into a
single mod where everything is a toggle. In singleplayer the player is the admin; on a

 rewards, sleep-rule overrides, and world progression -- every behavior you would
 normally stack separate sleep mods for, in one place, each one a toggle.

This mod lets you configure the health of Phantoms. In vanilla Minecraft, Phantoms have 20 HP—just like the player—which, in my opinion, is way too tanky for such an annoying mob. This mod reduces their health to just 1 HP by default, making them killable with a single punch. But if you want to, you can change their hp to whatever you like. For example, setting their HP to 10 means they'll only be one-tapped by a Sharpness V diamond sword. 
 
 
 
 Configuration 
 You can configure this mod either directly in-game or by editing the JSON file config/onetapphantoms.json in your profile folder. 
 phantom hp - the default amount of hp phantoms spawn with

tntqueue:
TNTQueue
This a mod that prevents excessive server lag caused by large amounts of primed TNT.
It does this by limiting the number of TNT entities that can be active at the same time.

When the active TNT count exceeds the configured limit, additional TNT is placed into a queue and activated later, ensuring explosions remain manageable without overwhelming the server.

 Warning: this may break the vanilla behavior of TNT, as the logic of its spawn has changed. 

---

 
 
 

---

 Configuration
The mod provides two configurable options, which can be adjusted either manually in the config file or via an in-game command:

 maxPrimedTntAmount : — The maximum number of primed TNT entities allowed to exist simultaneously.

 maxQueueSize : — The maximum number of TNT entities that can be stored in the queue.

 ⚠️ Default values are arbitrary and should be tuned for your specific server setup.

 Enchantment limit

Each item can be enchanted with a maximum of 2 enchantments, one "prefix" and one "suffix" enchantment.

 Tiny bees buzzing through a forest clearing. 

 

 Smaller spiders. Easier to miss, harder to keep out.

- Buffers your raw mouse-look input and releases only a fraction of it per frame, producing a soft, interpolated camera that "catches up" to your mouse.
- Strength is fully adjustable from 0% (instant / vanilla) up to heavy 95% smoothing.
- A small top-left indicator ( Smooth 65% ) shows the current strength while the mod is enabled.
- Your settings (on/off + strength) are saved to a config file and restored next launch.

 Controls
- K — toggle smoothing on/off (default off , so installing changes nothing until you switch it on).
- [ — decrease smoothing strength by 5%.

joinqueue:
JoinQueue

Versions: NeoForge 1.21.1 & 1.21.8

Prevents server crashes and TPS drops caused by many players joining at the same time (e.g., after a restart or during events). The mod puts connecting players into a waiting line during the Configuration Phase, preventing the Main Thread from overloading.

Features
Activation: With default settings the queue is always active (queue activation threshold = 0). Set a threshold to only activate above a given online player count. It also force-activates during the grace period after a server restart (default 60s) or whenever TPS drops below 8.0.
TPS Check: Players are only released while the server is stable (TPS ≥ 8.0) and the queue is not paused. Releasing stops automatically during heavy lag.
Release Rate: Players are let in on a timer — by default every 2s (normal) and every 1s (VIP), configurable via ticks between joins / ticks between join

chandlers-optimizations:
Chandler’s Optimizations improves Better than Adventure’s terrain renderer so larger render distances are more practical.

The mod raises the render distance limit to 64 chunks and reworks parts of the old beta-style chunk renderer to reduce wasted CPU work. It uses a smarter chunk rebuild queue, avoids repeatedly scanning and sorting huge numbers of chunk renderers, and caches more of the renderer’s internal terrain state instead of recalculating it constantly. There are also options to prioritize loading chunks in the Frustum and turn on Multidraw to make fuller use of the GPU.

The result is smoother performance and faster terrain loading especially at high render distances.

The mod also includes an in-game profiler overlay (can change hotkey in controls) and benchmark tools used during development to measure frame time, chunk rebuild work, and terrain rendering cost.

Requires BTA F

- Control the mod by toggling active state, changing Hz, and switching AUTO or MANUAL mode

- Manage config profiles by saving, loading, and listing them programmatically

And it does it without explanation.

It removes the player’s head.

- It does not improve performance.
- It does not ask questions.

- No gameplay impact (aside from existential dread)

 Perfect for: 
- Meme mod packs
- Budget horror setups

 Features

- Calculates and renders the exact trajectory of your projectile.
- Dynamically highlights the predicted impact point (blue for blocks, red for entities).

Developed by Christar Entertain Company (1980–2003) 

In gaming history, few stories are as strange as the one surrounding the so-called Minecraft PS1 Prototype . Long before Mojang or Markus Persson, a small European studio named Christar Entertain Company experimented with voxel-based terrain engines as early as 1980—an era when 3D graphics were still in their infancy.

Their most ambitious project, internally titled " CaveGame: Earth Edition ", was demonstrated privately at E3 on May 12, 1995 , running on early PlayStation hardware. The demo showcased a procedurally generated landscape made of cubes, dynamic lighting, and primitive weather effects—technology considered nearly impossible for the time.

After Christar declared bankruptcy on 23 October 2003 , their headquarters near Bucharest, Romania , were left to decay. The facility was demolished in 2008 , but a group of preservation

Welcome to Re: Optimized , a modpack for Minecraft designed for players who want to maximize their enjoyment with enhanced performance and graphics quality. This pack includes numerous useful mods that optimize your gameplay experience and add new features without overloading your system.

 Key Mods:

- Sodium + Sodium Extra : Significantly improves game performance by reducing CPU and GPU load.
- Iris : Enables the use of shaders, creating stunningly beautiful landscapes.
- Lithium : Further optimizes the world, making it more responsive and faster.
- Entity Culling : Reduces rendering of objects outside your field of view, increasing FPS.
- Dynamic FPS : Automatically lowers frame rates when inactive to save energy.
- Mod Menu : A convenient interface for managing all installed mods.

 Interface Enhancements:

- BetterPingDisplay : Displ

rokyn:
Rokyn' is a modpack that brings a modern atmosphere to Minecraft. It includes various vehicles, weapons, and decorative mods that make city life possible. The pack really shines when used with a city map — that’s when the world starts to feel alive. You can drive around, decorate apartments, cook, or even set up your own small roleplay server with friends.

It also features Plasmo Voice for in-game voice chat, an economy system with different currencies, and popular mods like Farmer’s Delight, Security Craft, and several Macaw’s furniture packs. In the future, I plan to add a custom currency mod to make trading more convenient.

Whether you want to explore, build, or just hang out with friends in a modern Minecraft world, this modpack gives you plenty of ways to have fun.

PS - I couldn't add my own mod because of an mcreator bug.

 Join the Discord server for feedback and questions.

New World overhauls and changes a lot of what you would find in Vanilla Minecraft, so the rest of this description will serve to walk you through some of the more influential changes, sequentially from top-to-bottom for how much they affect the game!

Ever making a new Minecraft world, settling along a lovely river, but wait, what's that on the mountain there? An Ugly village with Cubes of dirt everywhere!
You find a beautiful and flat plains... 5 Villages are already there claiming all the good real estate for themselves.
Removing Villages isn't about remo

[!Note!] Thanks for the 490 downloads :)

I built this pack because I missed the feeling of actually being afraid of the dark in Minecraft. It’s called The Castel Experience, and it’s less about "jump scares" and more about that skin-crawling feeling that you’re being watched by something that doesn't follow the rules of the game. It turns a sandbox into a psychological trap where the goal isn't just to build—it's to stay sane.

You might feel the urge to swing your sword at the shadows, but you’ll quickly realize the truth: You can try to strike them, but you can't hit something that isn't really there.

How it works

The "twist" here is that I’ve layered several different "stalker" entities that all behave differently. While From The Fog handles the classic, subtle legend of Herobrine, mods like The Anomaly and The Obsessed focus on messing with your head—distorting your vision, playin

[！注意！]感谢您的490次下载：） 我制作这个背包，是因为我怀念《我的世界》中那种真正害怕黑暗的感觉。它被称为“卡斯特体验”（The Castel Experience），它不太像是“跳跃恐惧”，而更像是那种被不遵守游戏规则的东西盯着的毛骨悚然的感觉。它把一个沙箱变成了一个心理陷阱，目标不仅仅是构建，而是保持理智。 你可能会有一种冲动，想把剑挥向影子，但你很快就会意识到真相：你可以试着去攻击它们，但你无法击中那些并不存在的东西。 它是如何工作 这里的“转折点”是，我把几个不同的“跟踪者”实体分层，它们的行为都不一样。《迷雾中》处理的是Herobrine经典而微妙的传奇故事，而《反常者》和《痴迷者》等模组则专注于扰乱你的头脑--扭曲你的视觉，玩弄你的游戏。

You can create your own worlds and play with your friends with the same mods as the creators play with, all with a central point of Fossils and Archeology: Revival. This has been made possible by optimizing the heck out of the pack, allowing for playing at as low as 2GB of RAM on some systems! 

There are quite the few things to explore alongside the main mod, including create and some of its addons, ad astra for an intersting space based raptor to bring home from the martian surface, and many many other mods that add bunches of building blocks to make your parks and enclosure look as pretty as you want!

For this pack, we personally recommend a setting of 6GB of RAM, and to not go higher than 12.
If you have any questions, feel free to ask in the public Discord!

afk-display:
AFK Display

Free and open-source datapack for Minecraft 1.21 and higher that displays whether a player is afk or not next to their nickname.

 Features

If you remain afk (i.e. he doesn't move at all) between 2 minutes 30 seconds and 5 minutes, you will be added to the afk team. Belonging to this afk team adds you after your nickname: [AFK].

This status will be automatically displayed next to each nickname in a list or sidebar or in the chat if the player speaks while afk.

If you move again while assigned to the afk team, you will be removed from that team and the [AFK] next to your nickname will be automatically deleted.

You can use the /trigger afk command to display afk for other players.

 Uninstall

To uninstall the datapack, simply run the following command : /function afk display:uninstall

no-griefing-creepers:
This datapack disables creeper griefing without needing to disable mobGriefing .

 Why not disable mobGriefing ?

Disabling mobGriefing comes with several disadvantages, such as:

- Blaze fireballs creating fire
- Rabbits eating crops
- Sheep eating grass blocks
- Silverfish calling for help out of nearby blocks destroying said blocks
- Silverfish hiding in stone (Silverfish will not reinhabit stone blocks after roaming)
- Snowmen leaving snow traces
- Villagers harvesting/replanting farmland
- Villagers not being able to pick up bread
- etc.

This datapack only disables creeper griefing without disabling any of those other things.

 Setting up this datapack

 CP 1400 Locomotive
The CP Class 1400 are a series of 67 diesel-electric locomotives built for the Portuguese Railways (CP) between 1967 and 1969. They have a top speed of 105 km/h.

They were ordered primarily to replace steam locomotives then still in use on CP. Designed and engineered by English Electric, they are closely modelled mechanically on the British Rail Class 20 locomotives but using a more powerful intercooled 1,330 bhp 8CSVT version of the Class 20's 8SVT engine. The locomotives were designed for the 1,668 mm (5 ft 5+21⁄32 in) Iberian gauge and larger loading gauge than possible in United Kingdom. The first ten were built in England at the Vulcan Foundry in Newton-le-Will

chattyping: The plugin uses ProtocolLib to send packets directly to clients that create and configure virtual text display entities. These entities show text floating above the player and are mounted on the player via a MOUNT packet but do not exist as actual entities in the server world. This method avoids server-side entity overhead, reduces lag and plugin conflicts, and ensures that only players within a certain radius see the messages. The plugin also respects player states such as muted, vanished, or spectator mode, preventing message display in these cases.
该插件使用ProtocolLib将数据包直接发送到创建和配置虚拟文本显示实体的客户端。这些实体显示在播放器上方浮动的文本，并通过MOUNT数据包安装在播放器上，但在服务器世界中并不作为实际实体存在。该方法避免了服务器端实体开销，减少了延迟和插件冲突。并确保只有在一定范围内的玩家才能看到消息。该插件还尊重玩家的状态，如静音，消失或观众模式，防止在这些情况下显示消息。

 ChatPatcher is a Velocity plugin that removes the signed chat messages feature introduced in Minecraft 1.19+
If you’ve encountered errors such as:

- “A plugin tried to cancel a signed chat message”
- “A proxy plugin caused an illegal protocol state”

 you're likely to require this one! 

for reference
---

 Why Use ChatPatcher?

With the release of Minecraft 1.19.1, Mojang introduced mandatory signed chat messages to enhance security and message integrity. While this change aims to reduce abuse and ensure authenticity, it has inadvertently caused compatibility issues for networks relying on Velocity's chat manipulation features. ChatPatcher removes these restrictions, restoring the classic chat handling that many servers have long depended on.
